collection.title: NEXUS App Hub v11
collection.description: Data-driven modular portal based on v10, backed by a server-side artifact catalog compiler.

validate.description: Validate required fields and source availability before indexing.

copy.description: Copy local artifact files into the hub deployment tree so they become hub-based.

index.description: Keep item in the clean compiled artifact list for menu/search/launch use.

items.title: Badger Sprawl Runner
items.description: Built Vite artifact for the sprite-first cyber-badger 2D platformer.

items.title: Label Sheet Studio
items.description: Local-first DIN A4 label designer with configurable equal-cell rows and columns, draggable grid positioning and resizing, repeated images or auto-fitting text, and exact-size print-ready PDF export.

items.title: File Diff Studio
items.description: Self-contained local-first text and file comparison studio with DWIM two-slot paste, uploads and drop, live Myers line diffing, a persistent diff-first workspace, collapsible regions, draggable and keyboard-operable dividers, stacked or side-by-side long-line review, non-destructive result assembly, undo and redo, and an exportable replayable JSON journal.

items.title: Nakamoto's Disciples
items.description: Interactive local-first Bitcoin course with six sequential mastery flows, fail-closed phase and persisted-state integrity, accessible repair feedback, read-only completed evidence, real protocol experiments, and gated implementation references from bytes through Nakamoto consensus.

items.title: Aether Node
items.description: Abstract node-based visual programming tool for creating generative graphics and procedural patterns. Build networks of processing nodes, connect data flows, and export results as images or animations.

items.title: BrickBreaker Coop
items.description: Cooperative brick-breaking arcade game with multiplayer support via PeerJS. Features powerups, progressive difficulty, and synchronized state management for networked play.

items.title: Chadō: Interactive Zen Tea Ceremony Guide
items.description: Self-contained interactive guide to chanoyu / chadō with a meditative step-by-step ceremony path, animated tea-room illustrations, wa-kei-sei-jaku interpretation lenses, practice timer, etiquette quiz, glossary, and embedded source notes.

items.title: Classic Minesweeper
items.description: Standalone Minesweeper artifact with original presets, custom boards, timer scoring, flags, chording, keyboard controls, and local best times.

items.title: Classic Solitaire
items.description: Standalone Klondike Solitaire artifact with draw-one/draw-three modes, stock and waste piles, foundations, tableau moves, scoring, undo, auto-foundation, timer, and best score persistence.

items.title: Clausewitz: On War Interactive Atlas
items.description: Self-contained interactive atlas for exploring Clausewitz's On War through book trees, chapter compartments, concept maps, friction and culminating-point simulations, scenario sliders, and retrieval prompts.

items.title: Club Ledger
items.description: Client-only trusted club finance ledger for importing JSON, inspecting member dues and wallet balances, logging membership fees, transactions, and wallet-to-wallet conversions, then exporting updated JSON.

items.title: GIF White→Alpha Preprocessor
items.description: Browser-based GIF preprocessor that removes white backgrounds and replaces with transparency. Upload animated GIF, adjust white threshold with live preview, and download cleaned GIF with proper alpha channel.

items.title: Gridblast Bomberman
items.description: Legacy v10 Bomberman implementation with PeernetLobby one-session multiplayer, target-peer joins, and shared state snapshots.

items.title: Magical Love Chat
items.description: P2P real-time chat application with magical theme and PeerJS networking. Features private messaging, room creation, user presence, emoji support, and persistent chat history via localStorage.

items.title: Markdown Viewer
items.description: Theme-compliant rendered Markdown viewer for catalog docs and local pasted/dropped Markdown files.

items.title: Meme Lab
items.description: Single-file meme generator with template system, drag-and-drop image support, crop editing, text overlay, and PNG export. Features canvas auto-expansion, layer management, undo/redo, clipboard paste, and JSON template save/load for reusable meme compositions.

items.title: NEXUS v10 Classic Portal
items.description: The clean PeernetLobby app runtime v11 is based on.

items.title: NEXUS v10 Enhanced Portal
items.description: The rich v10 portal containing themes, sound, floating panels, and storage management ideas externalized in v11 libs.

items.title: NEXUS v10 Full Portal
items.description: Full v10 portal compatibility surface for PeernetLobby apps, notepad, shared text pad, sequencer, PeerModGroove launcher, peer console, linked artifacts, and sprite GIF launcher.

items.title: NEXUS v9 Full Portal
items.description: Full v9 portal kept as a legacy compatibility surface for all v9 embedded tools: artifacts, notepad, calculator, color picker, palette, lobby chat, local snapshots, mini file, shared sessions, shooter game, and unified user settings.

items.title: PDF Forge Nexus
items.description: Client-side PDF manipulator with merge, split, and conversion capabilities. Features drag-and-drop PDF/image loading, page reordering, rotation, multi-page merge, PDF splitting (by N pages, at page, range, or each page), PDF to text extraction, image to PDF conversion, and preview. All processing happens locally with no server upload.

items.title: PeerModGroove
items.description: Peer-synchronized modular audio app launched from v10/v11 rather than embedded into the hub runtime.

items.title: Prompt Forge Nexus
items.description: Advanced LLM prompt generator with placeholder system, tag-based filtering, prompt operations library, assembly multi-prompt combiner, and 7 cyberpunk themes. Pure client-side with localStorage persistence, export/import, and live preview.

items.title: QR Studio
items.description: Professional QR code generator supporting 12+ formats (URL, text, WiFi, TOTP, eSIM, email, phone, SMS, contact, location, event, vCard). Includes error correction levels, custom colors, PNG/SVG export, print support, and real-time preview.

items.title: RevealPeerJS
items.description: Reveal.js plugin that connects all slide viewers in a P2P lobby with chat, live polls, Pong challenges, and a top-down arena shooter mini-game.

items.title: Sprite Fan Atlas Studio
items.description: Integrated sprite-sheet cleanup, review, postprocessing, repack, PNG export, and sprites.json/review-report manifest studio for generated sprite assets.

items.title: Sprite GIF Creator
items.description: Browser-only sprite-sheet splitter, frame editor, PNG exporter, and animated GIF assembler.

items.title: Sprite GIF Creator v2
items.description: Enhanced sprite sheet animator with timeline, frame editing, multiple source support, batch processing, and GIF export. Features source card management, improved batch operations, and pixel-perfect preview controls.

items.title: Storyboard Studio
items.description: Client-side illustration and text document builder for arranging imported images, prose, captions, blueprint blocks, slogans, and quotes into printable or self-contained HTML storyboard artifacts.

items.title: Telegram Bot API Workbench
items.description: Security-conscious, self-contained browser console for Telegram bots with status and webhook diagnostics, messaging, update polling, command and chat inspection, generic JSON and multipart method runners, abortable requests, reusable JavaScript snippets, safe profile exchange, and token-redacted logs.

items.title: Template Engine
items.description: Template processing engine for creating and managing reusable design templates. Supports variable substitution, conditional rendering, loops, and custom processing logic for generating dynamic content from templates.

items.title: v8 Collab Code Editor
items.description: Full Monaco-based collaborative code editor from the earlier app hub line, exposed through the v11 catalog.

items.title: v8 Collab Pad Lite
items.description: Textarea-based collaborative editor from the earlier app hub line, exposed through the v11 catalog.

items.title: Ethic Brawl
items.description: Built Vite artifact for the cyberpunk philosophical arena-brawler; package/deploy copies dist output only.

items.title: V11 Peer DAW
items.description: Built Vite artifact for the modular peer-to-peer audio workstation; package/deploy copies dist output only.

items.title: Procedural Sharepic Studio
items.description: Most feature-rich sharepic generator with template system, procedural backgrounds, text effects, color themes, and export options. Create branded social media images with custom layouts, typography, filters, and batch processing capabilities.

items.title: Hyperblast Shooter
items.description: Classic cyberpunk space shooter with multiplayer hooks, progression systems, story mode, and floating-panel support inherited from the v10 enhanced portal.

items.title: Overlay Cam — Intuitive UX APK
items.description: Android debug APK with a simplified freeze-camera, add-overlay, direct gesture adjustment, fine-tuning, and save workflow.

items.title: Git Recipe Book
items.description: Static HTML artifact for an interactive Git learning app; deploy copies dist output only.

items.title: Font Lab Browser
items.description: Single-file, browser-only font builder. Upload a glyph grid image, remove white to transparency, smooth and trace, then export an OTF plus debug assets.

items.title: Palette Studio
items.description: Advanced palette generator with multiple anchors, role inference, contrast checks, and CSS variable export for readable UI themes.

items.description: Native textarea-based v8 scratchpad port in the v11 legacy utility host with local-first autosave.

items.title: v9 Quick Notepad
items.description: v9 embedded Quick Notepad ported to the v11 utility host with local-first autosave.

items.title: v9 Sci-Fi Calculator
items.description: Cyberpunk calculator from the v9 embedded utility deck, ported as a standalone v11 tool with history tape.
